claims.claim: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent may skip an APEC finance ministers meeting in Hong Kong to focus on preparing for President Donald Trump’s planned visit to Shenzhen in November.
claims.episode_span: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent may skip an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation finance ministers meeting in Hong Kong later this month.
claims.source_title: Bessent may skip Apec in Hong Kong to focus on Trump’s Shenzhen visit, sources say
claims.supporting_quote: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent may skip a meeting of Apec finance ministers in Hong Kong later this month to focus on preparing for President Donald Trump’s historic visit to Shenzhen in November, sources told the South China Morning Post.

claims.claim: Malaysian authorities closed schools in Kuala Lumpur and other parts of the country on Friday due to haze caused by forest fires in nearby Indonesia.
claims.episode_span: Malaysian authorities ordered school closures in Kuala Lumpur and several states on Friday after air quality readings reached unhealthy levels.
claims.source_title: Malaysia shuts schools amid toxic haze from Indonesian fires
claims.supporting_quote: Malaysian authorities closed schools in the capital, Kuala Lumpur, and other parts of the country on Friday due to haze caused by forest fires in nearby Indonesia.

claims.claim: Japan’s government plans to reduce the consumption tax on food and non-alcoholic beverages from 8 percent to 1 percent starting in April.
claims.episode_span: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s government plans to submit a bill reducing the consumption tax on food and non-alcoholic beverages from 8 percent to 1 percent starting in April.
claims.source_title: Government to submit bill on food consumption tax reduction to parliament
claims.supporting_quote: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's government plans to reduce the food and nonalcoholic beverage consumption tax from 8% to 1% starting in April.

claims.claim: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said interest rates may need to rise even as the UK economy weakens.
claims.episode_span: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said in a speech that interest rates may need to increase even as the UK economy weakens.
claims.source_title: Bailey warns interest rates may rise even as the UK economy weakens
claims.supporting_quote: The Bank of England’s Governor has delivered a clear warning on Thursday: interest rates may need to rise even as the economy weakens.

claims.claim: The yuan advanced to a four-year high against a basket of its trading partners’ currencies after the People’s Bank of China rejected claims of undervaluation.
claims.episode_span: The yuan advanced to a four-year high against a basket of currencies after the People’s Bank of China rejected claims of undervaluation and defended its exchange-rate management.
claims.source_title: Yuan Hits Four-Year High Versus Basket as PBOC Backs FX Policy
claims.supporting_quote: The yuan advanced to a four-year high against a basket of its trading partners’ currencies after the People’s Bank of China rejected claims of undervaluation and defended its exchange-rate management.
